title: Infeudation
summary: INFEUDA'TION, noun [in and feudum, feud.] 1. The act of putting one in possession of an estate in fee. 2. The granting of tithes to laymen.

inlines.v: INFEUDA'TION, noun [in and feudum, feud.] 1. The act of putting one in possession of an estate in fee. 2. The granting of tithes to laymen.
